releaseNotes.title: What's new in Colwerk {version}
releaseNotes.unavailable: The release notes could not be loaded.

connection.name: Name
connection.clientIdHelp: Your own app registration. Empty = Microsoft's developer app
connection.catalogUrlHelp: Iceberg REST catalog, e.g. Apache Polaris, Lakekeeper or Nessie
connection.catalogHelp: Default catalog; the others can be selected in the toolbar
connection.workspaceHelp: Name or ID of the Fabric workspace
connection.lakehouseHelp: Default lakehouse; the others can be selected in the toolbar
connection.regionHelp: Region of the S3 storage, e.g. eu-central-1. Not needed on Azure and Google Cloud
connection.deltaFolderHelp: Absolute path of a folder with Delta tables (subfolders with _delta_log), or of one table
connection.entraUserHelp: Entra user or group as created in the database

entraHelp.entra-default: Uses the sign-in of az login, Azure PowerShell, azd or AZURE_* environment variables.
entraHelp.entra-interactive: Opens the browser to sign in when connecting. The sign-in lasts until Colwerk quits. MCP clients only use an existing sign-in.
entraHelp.entra-service-principal: Signs in with an app registration and its client secret.

socketHelp.postgres: Directory of the socket, e.g. /var/run/postgresql. Replaces the host.
socketHelp.mysql: Path to the socket, or the named pipe on Windows. Replaces host and port.

connection.searchPathHelp: Schemas searched for unqualified names. Empty = server setting
connection.instanceNameHelp: Through the SQL Server Browser (UDP 1434), replaces the port
connection.connectRetriesHelp: Retries on transient errors, e.g. while Azure SQL serverless resumes
connection.languageHelp: SET LANGUAGE, e.g. Deutsch. Determines messages and date format
connection.dateFormatHelp: SET DATEFORMAT for dates given as text
connection.readOnlyIntentHelp: ApplicationIntent=ReadOnly: routes to readable replicas of an Availability Group or Azure SQL.
connection.multiSubnetFailoverHelp: Faster reconnects after a failover of Availability Group listeners spanning several subnets.
connection.sslServerNameHelp: When connecting through an IP address or alias while the certificate is issued for another name
connection.sslStrictHelp: TLS before the login, as required by SQL Server 2022 with “Force Strict Encryption”.
connection.caCertHelp: Path to a PEM file, e.g. for self-signed servers. Empty = system CAs.
connection.insecureHelp: Encrypted, but without protection against man-in-the-middle attacks.
connection.v1Storage: Create a new file compatible with DuckDB 1.x
connection.v1StorageHelp: Only applies when the file does not exist yet. DuckDB 1.x cannot open files in the format of DuckDB 2.
connection.colorHelp: Marks the connection in the list, in tabs and in the toolbar, e.g. red for production.
connection.confirmWritesHelp: Asks before running a statement that may change data or structures.
connection.sshTunnelHelp: Reach the server through an SSH server. Not available with Unix socket or named instance.
connection.sshAgentHelp: Uses the agent from SSH_AUTH_SOCK (Windows: the OpenSSH agent).
connection.sshHostKeyHelp: Recorded on the first connect; a different key is refused.

mcp.title: Set up MCP
mcp.description: Through MCP, AI assistants read structures and run SELECT queries on your connections. Colwerk must be running for this.

mcp.others: Other clients (e.g. Cursor, VS Code) take the same command as a stdio server.

errors.busy: A statement is already running in this tab.

errors.analyzeReadOnly: ANALYZE executes the statement and is only available for read-only statements.
errors.noResultSet: The statement returned no result set.
errors.driverMissing: The DuckDB driver is not installed. Open the connection in Colwerk and choose “Load database driver”.
errors.driverDownloadFailed: Download of the DuckDB driver failed: {detail}
errors.noFileDialog: No file dialog available: install zenity or kdialog.
errors.servicePrincipalRequired: A service principal needs a tenant ID and a client ID.
errors.entraLoginRequired: Microsoft Entra sign-in required: open the connection in Colwerk and sign in in the browser.
errors.clientIdRequired: OAuth2 client credentials need a client ID.
errors.addressRequired: Please enter the address of the catalog or workspace.
errors.folderRequired: Please enter the folder of the Delta tables.
errors.extensionFailed: The DuckDB extension {name} could not be loaded: {detail}
errors.sshForwardRefused: The SSH server could not connect to {host}:{port}: {detail}
errors.sshHostKeyChanged: The host key of the SSH server changed (now {fingerprint}, expected {expected}). If this is expected, forget the host key in the connection settings.
errors.sshNoAgent: No SSH agent found: SSH_AUTH_SOCK is not set.
errors.sshRequired: An SSH tunnel needs an SSH host and an SSH user.
errors.sshKeyRequired: Please enter the path of the private key file.
errors.sshNotCombinable: An SSH tunnel cannot be combined with a Unix socket or a named instance.
